more_beautiful.reason: B has a warm, consistent palette (cream, rust, forest green), a confident slab-serif hierarchy and a memorable tilted luggage-tag date card, so it looks more finished than A's tidy but plain page, which mixes mint, grey, yellow and magenta and leaves the desktop hero half empty. B does lose some polish to an organiser note visible to visitors and to its stock card grids.

less_generic.reason: A builds the whole page around one idea that fits the request, a ticket stub used for the logo stand-in and the half-hour arrival slots, and avoids landing-page clichés, while B uses a template structure (eyebrow, icon-card grid, numbered 3-step 'How it works', checklist, three-column footer) plus a visible note mentioning 'index.html' that makes visitors suspect it was generated.
